_doc: Short, bounded FIRST experiment (instructions only; nothing has been run). PPO fine-tuning of ONE head (objective) from the untrained zero-residual model against the pinned league on H's training-map partition. Requires: B's nfs.records + install_models model-dir support, C's nfs.obs byte encoder, a 'training_objective' profile (only objective active). Run: python tools/nfs.py rl --config configs/train/first_experiment.json --model-config configs/model/fs_v1.json --run-dir artifacts/runs/first-exp --i-authorize-training --time-limit-minutes 30
_stop_criteria: abort: PolicyParityError (C++/torch behaviour logp mismatch > 2e-3) - training data not from this policy
abort: any bot fault, invalid_action_rate > 0, or fallback_rate > 0.2 in a rollout batch
per update: KL early stop at 1.5 * target_kl; entropy collapse (< 0.05) is reported
hard: persisted wall-clock deadline (30 min) or max_games reached
after the run: H's selection schedule per reference opponent; promotion only via `promote` (H gate). Do not select on loss or pooled score.
